title: follow_viewport_scale does not return correct transform matrix
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1

### System information

Linux

### Issue description

This transformation matrix:
get_viewport().get_final_transform() * get_global_transform_with_canvas()

does not account for follow_viewport_scale correctly. I have no idea why the matrices look wrong. Godot renders everything correctly, but it's wrong in my scripts.

Please let me know if I am just multiplying these matrices incorrectly.

### Steps to reproduce

If you open my example project, the sprite has a script that will print its position in "Embedder coordinates". 

According to this article, it should account for follow-transforms correctly:
https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/contributing/development/core_and_modules/2d_coordinate_systems.html#godot-2d-coordinate-systems

The CanvasLayer script animates the follow_viewport_scale, but I expect the screen space coordinates of the sprite to remain at (250, 250). However, it actually changes between (0, 0) and (500, 500). The follow_viewport_scale seems to be applied towards screen-space 0, 0 instead of towards the camera center.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Archive.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21700045/Archive.zip)
